line.en: A broadcast package laid over the person's own footage.

for.en: A news-show package over your own footage: weekly roundups, briefings, interview shows. Needs your own video.
for.zh-CN: 叠在你自己画面上的新闻节目包装：周报、简报、访谈节目。需要你自己的视频。

not.en: Films with no footage of their own; quiet, personal subjects.
not.zh-CN: 没有自己素材的影片；安静、私人的题材。
